description: A private, practical coach for earning a first sale from digital products on a zero-rupee budget: checks which marketplaces an India-based seller can really use, builds print-ready worksheets with answer keys and listing copy, and tracks sales to decide what to improve.

defaultPrompt: Help me choose one digital product I can create for free and sell online.
Create a print-ready US Letter math worksheet pack with a separate answer key and listing copy.
Compare which marketplaces I can sell on from India, including GST, payouts and fees.
interface.longDescription: A step-by-step private assistant for an India-based seller targeting US buyers. It compares marketplaces using dated, sourced facts on seller eligibility, GST, payouts and fees; creates complete printable products (US Letter and A4 PDFs, separate answer keys, covers, previews, titles, descriptions and tags) with calculated answer checks; and turns weekly listing numbers into one clear next action. It favours free tools, one product at a time, and honest expectations rather than income promises.

name: digital-product-earning-assistant
